$comment: The reviewed token set of the default theme (scripts/check-tokens.mjs; theming-and-styling.md §10.8). Every token belongs to one family. A new token fails the check until it joins a family here, with a reviewer's reason; a role whose value only names another token also needs a description in packages/tokens/src/generate/preset.ts.

families.name: Reference palette
families.purpose: The palette ramps (ADR 0041). Only semantic roles read them; components never do.

families.name: Spacing
families.purpose: The spacing scale (theming-and-styling.md §4), scaled by density.

families.name: Radius
families.purpose: The corner scale; radius.scale generates its steps.

families.name: Border width
families.purpose: Hairline and strong strokes.

families.name: Focus
families.purpose: The focus ring's width and offset (WCAG 2.4.13).

families.name: Font family
families.purpose: Sans, display, and mono stacks; display is the brand's heading family.

families.name: Font size
families.purpose: The type scale; typography.scale generates it.

families.name: Font weight
families.purpose: The four weights the text styles use.

families.name: Line height
families.purpose: Unitless line heights of the text styles.

families.name: Letter spacing
families.purpose: Tracking of the text styles.

families.name: Icon size
families.purpose: Icon boxes.

families.name: Target
families.purpose: The minimum target size (WCAG 2.5.8); control and row heights never go below it.

families.name: Elevation
families.purpose: Shadows by surface: sm controls, md cards, lg popovers and menus, xl dialogs.

families.name: Motion
families.purpose: Durations (0ms under reduced motion) and easings.

families.name: Stacking
families.purpose: In-flow layers only; overlays use the top layer.

families.name: Control
families.purpose: The control box at sm, md, and lg, shared by every control so they line up; control.radius lets a theme round controls alone.

families.name: Text styles
families.purpose: The eight text styles (ADR 0042), each family, size, weight, line height, and letter spacing, so a style is used whole.

families.name: Colour: surfaces and text
families.purpose: Neutral roles (ADR 0041), checked by the contrast contracts.

families.name: Colour: action, link, and focus
families.purpose: Brand roles, each held to its own contrast minimum: labels on actions 4.5:1, links 4.5:1, the focus ring 3:1.

families.name: Colour: selection
families.purpose: Selected controls and rows, always with a second cue (a check or a marker).

families.name: Colour: tones
families.purpose: The five meaning tones (ADR 0045), each foreground, surface, and border.

families.name: Colour: decoration
families.purpose: The palette's decorative accent (ADR 0041); never status, text, or interaction.

families.name: Card
families.purpose: Contained surfaces (cards, dialogs, toasts, tables, trees); also odd-card's CSS properties.

families.name: Layout
families.purpose: Layout recipe roles: gaps, insets, and sizes; the layout.compact profile changes the gap and inset.

families.name: Navigation
families.purpose: Side nav and tree rows; the navigation.compact profile changes them.

offered.color.accent.decorative: Offered to consumers for decoration (ADR 0041, theming-and-styling.md §10.1); no Oddkin element draws decoration.
